rule: number of singular values of the fixed-sigma complex stack T = H/sigma above 3(sqrt(KM)+sqrt(N))
status: operational cutoff specified after acquisition (decision #70(iii), 2026-11-05); not a demonstrated false-alarm probability or a universal physical limit
noise_convention: sigma(tone, mic) = rms of the nine baseline recordings about their mean, ddof 1, one recording, E|n|^2 = sigma^2; B6 uses the baseline of B
drive_convention: H from the mean of nine calibration recordings minus the baseline mean, not divided by the AO phasor; singular values are per unit-norm drive vector in units of the calibration drive per speaker (0.1 V/ch, v = 1)
